decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Sheet 1, Location Plan received 28/02/2014 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 4 - The planting on the proposed hardstanding shall be permanently retained.
Condition : 5 - The materials to be used in the construction of the hardstanding shall be permeable.

Condition : 6 - The vehicle crossover hereby permitted shall be made available for use by a disabled person with restricted movement, who is permanently resident at the property. If that person ceases to live at the property, the footway shall be re-instated at the applicant's expense within six months.
description: Formation of vehicle access and forecourt hardstanding.
